newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TOURVEST BUYS BATCH OF FIRMS FOR 19MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: TOURVEST BUYS BATCH OF FIRMS FOR 19MLN RAND.

text.p: Tourism Investment Corp Ltd (Tourvest) said on Thursday it had acquired a handful of firms for some 19 million rand.

The acquisitions formed part of its plan to create a jewellery group focussed on inbound tourism in Cape Town and also formed part of its strategy to identify and acquire strategic tourism assets, it said.

In line with its first objective, it said it had acquired a 60 percent interest in Centenary Jewellers with effect from July 1 and Sorelle Parenti Jewellers and Renee's Antique Jewellery with effect from August 25 and September 3 respectively.
Tourvest would combine and rationalise these businesses under the Pinns group in a single company in which it would hold a 60 percent interest.
The acquired firms currently have a total of six outlets in Cape Town.

As part of its strategy to acquire tourism assets, Tourvest said it had acquired 60 percent of jewellery manufacturer B. Haglund with effect from August 1 and the business of Namibian inbound tour service provider TransNamibia Tours.

The deals would be settled through the isue of some 7.7 million new Touvest shares at 150 cents each, while a further 4.3 million shares would be issued and a cash payment of 797,000 rand would be made subject to minimum profit warranties being met by the respective businesses.
Tourvest added that based on profits warranted by the businesses, the acquisitions would increase its forecast earnings per share to 6.1 cents in the year to June 1998 against a forecast 5.5 cents.
